_doc: ERA 3, THE PHONE — the group, the backlog, and the ending. Built 2026-08-24 from ERA3_NARRATIVE.md §2, §4, §5, §6 and §7, and written against docs/reinterp/RESEARCH_PULL_E3_2026-08-24.md. Claude's writing under CLAUDE.md's 2026-08-17 amendment; Sérgio owns every ethics call and his edit wins. THE GROUP IS NEVER SATIRISED — the research is explicit that warmth, friendship, vulnerability and surveillance can all be materially genuine at once, and that the caricature to avoid is constant cruelty. These women are good to each other inside a frame that is harming them, and the piece's position is that they are not stupid for being there.
_docResearch: WHAT IS SOURCED: a facilitator rather than a leaderless circle (Deirdre); accountability that covers feelings and anticipated risk rather than only acts (Hanne discloses that nothing happened); a lapse met with confession and continuing rather than expulsion; the women's-strand vocabulary (emotional dependency, boundaries, unmet need) used sparingly and never stacked; and progress language that is processual — walking, healing, wholeness. WHAT IS DELIBERATELY ABSENT because it is [VERIFY SOURCE]: any term of direct address (no 'sister', no 'sweet friend' — they use ordinary names), any greeting formula, any emoji convention, any escalation ladder for a reported lapse, any word for a woman who leaves, and any claim that daily group check-ins were a standard ex-lesbian form. The group's name and every member are invented. The record is thin here and the piece writes into that gap openly rather than borrowing authority it does not have.
_docMalta: MALTA IS A CONNECTION POINT, NOT A FINDING (§7.3, Sérgio: 'pretend newspaper, with real information — not a finding, never claimed it as one'). The masthead is invented; the law is real. Malta's Affirmation of Sexual Orientation, Gender Identity and Gender Expression Act — Act LV of 2016 — was passed unanimously and made Malta the first country in Europe to ban conversion practices. Bea's two messages are the two states the design asks for: about to be finalised, then enacted. ⛑ THE DATE, AND A CORRECTION TO MY OWN EARLIER NOTE HERE: a previous version of this file claimed Sérgio had said the birthday coupon 'arrives while she is working', and that I was departing from his design by not doing that. HE SAID NO SUCH THING. He was describing the GROUP's messages arriving during the shift; the coupon was his example of what is ALREADY sitting in her SMS. So nothing here departs from him: the lock screen reads 13 December, which keeps Act LV's real timeline intact, and the coupon dated 14 March has been unopened in the backlog for nine months — which is exactly the inbox he described.

_docBefore: THE GROUP BEFORE ANYTHING HAPPENS. Ordinary Tuesday texture, and it has to be genuinely warm or the ending does not land. Hanne's message is the accountability mechanic rendered as friendship: she discloses a temptation rather than an act, to the group rather than to a leader, and is met with encouragement rather than correction. That is the documented shape and it is also, plainly, four women being kind to somebody having a bad night.

_docMaltaOne: BEA'S FIRST MESSAGE — 'it might happen'. She is not campaigning. She is a woman inside the same apparatus reading the news on her break, and the reason it matters to her is not political. ⚑ S149 — THE LINK CARD IS IN THE THREAD NOW. `phoneE3.ts` publishes the pressable `link` rect only while drawing a message of `kind: 'link'`, and no message carried that kind — so the article card (`link` below: masthead, headline, 'Tap to open') was never drawn, the card could never be opened, the stage could never leave `first`, and the group's cascade — the era's ending — was unreachable from the phone. Sérgio, 09-17 (R3-79): 'I opened the chat and nothing happened.' The era used to end on the work count instead, over her open job; it ends on the cascade now (era3Devices.tick), which this message makes reachable.

_docBlock: ⚑ CAPTURE EITHER WAY (§4), AND IT IS THE ERA'S THESIS AS A MECHANIC. Open the link and Lambient knows. Ignore it and Lambient comes anyway. The two cards say very nearly the same sentence, and NEITHER IS A PUNISHMENT — no warning, no reprimand, no consequence offered or threatened. It has simply been passed on. A player who behaves perfectly gets the same visit as one who does not, which is what removes 'keep your head down' as a strategy. ⚑ Lambient stays polite to the very end (§7.2) — there is no version of these strings where it becomes hostile.

_docCascade: ⚑ THE CASCADE IS VOLUME, NOT DAMAGE (§7.2). No crash screen, no corruption, no glitch glyphs, no error state. THE BLOCK KEEPS WORKING, CORRECTLY, ON MESSAGE AFTER MESSAGE — there are simply more messages than blocks. The software is not broken. It is outnumbered. ⚑ AND IT IS NOT VERA WHO DOES IT: she sends nothing here. Deirdre — the woman who runs the group, who moved Thursday's call so Susan could get there — is in the middle of it, and people are being ADDED to the group while it happens. That is 'the system collapses if everyone no longer performs it', and it is why the ending is collective and has no heroine.

cascade.text: putting it in the other group as well

_docOutnumbered: ⚑ THE ONE LINE THE SOFTWARE SAYS WHEN IT LOSES, and it is administrative rather than dramatic. It does not say it failed. It says it could not get to all of them — which is the same thing, in the voice of something that has never once raised its voice.
_docAfter: ⚑ 'YOU CAN'T UNSEE IT' (§7.2) is the beat's real ending, and it is the worst line in the era precisely because it is warm, true, and helpful. The tasks are still there, still working, still greyable, and now unusable in a way NOTHING ENFORCES. No lock, no error, no refusal — the board simply cannot be looked at the same way, and the software has no idea.

_docBacklog: THE ERA'S RESPITE AND ITS CRUELTY IN ONE INBOX (§6), and it needs no commentary at all. DESIGN LAW: the piece never makes her open them. They can be read, all of them, at any time, and NOTHING IS FILED EITHER WAY. If a player never touches this, that is also true of her. ⚑ THE WICK is an invented bar. Its birthday message is dated 14 March — Sérgio's date for her, day and month only, no year — and has been sitting unread for nine months; the second one is from today and is about nothing. ⚑ NONE OF THESE PEOPLE ARGUE WITH HER. Not one of them mentions the programme, asks her a question, or wants anything. That is the whole point of the inbox.
